Talent0_2Ability.name: Unceasing Thunderfire
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: When attacking with a Rocket Launcher, if <color=#F74848>3</color> or more targets are hit, restores <color=#F74848>2</color> AP after combat. Can only trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

Talent3_5Ability.name: Unceasing Thunderfire
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects: When attacking with a Rocket Launcher, if <color=#F74848>3</color> or more targets are hit, restores <color=#F74848>2</color> AP after combat. Can only trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn. Rocket Launcher Weight: <color=#F74848>-130</color>.

400001.name: Strategic Bombing 1
400001.SpecificEffects: When a Tactical Weapon runs out of ammo, trigger <buf ID=900029>[Auto Load]</buf>. This process takes <color=#F74848>3</color> turns.

700015.name: Strategic Redundancy
700015.SpecificEffects: At end of action, if no damage was dealt this turn, restores <color=#F74848>1</color> AP.

400403.name: Fullness
400403.describe: Fully reloads all Rocket Launcher Ammo and gains <buf ID=7100403>[Crit Rate UP II]</buf> for <color=#F74848>1</color> turn. Can continue action with remaining Movement.

700024.name: Graphite Warhead
700024.describe: Uses a Rocket Launcher to attack all targets within a <range type=1>3x3-tile area</range>, dealing <color=#F74848>0.25x</color> AoE DMG. Inflicts <buf ID=3006502>[Short Circuit I]</buf> on targets hit. Can trigger only <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

400405.name: Fill the Gap
400405.SpecificEffects: At start of action, reloads <color=#F74848>1</color> Ammo shell into the non-exhausted Rocket Launcher magazine with the lowest Ammo count.

400406.name: Everywhere
400406.describe: Simultaneously uses two Rocket Launchers to attack all targets within the selected <range type=1>5x5-tile area</range>, dealing <color=#F74848>0.175x</color> AoE DMG <color=#F74848>2</color> times.

400407.name: Bestowal
400407.SpecificEffects: When executing an AoE attack with a Rocket Launcher, depending on the type of ST hit, inflicts <buf ID=7101103>[Dodge Rate Down II]</buf>, <buf ID=7101801>[DMG Taken UP I]</buf>, or <buf ID=7101704>[Armor Down I]</buf> after combat, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

400408.name: Inferno
400408.SpecificEffects: Rocket Launcher DMG <color=#F74848>+10%</color>. When executing an AoE attack with the <color=#F74848>1st</color> round of Ammo in the rocket launcher magazine, applies <terrian ID=4003081 /> to the tiles hit after combat, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

400409.name: Cross Bombing
400409.describe: Uses a Rocket Launcher to attack all targets within a 1-tile cross area, dealing <color=#F74848>0.25x</color> AoE DMG, and an additional <color=#F74848>15%</color> DMG to the target in the center tile.

400031.name: Indiscriminate 1
400031.SpecificEffects: After the first attack with a Tactical Weapon each turn, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered, with Final DMG <color=#F74848>-30%</color>, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn. Unable to move before attacking.

400033.name: Strategic Bombing 4
400033.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=900029>[Auto Load]</buf> is complete, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP.

400034.name: Indiscriminate 2
400034.SpecificEffects: When attacking with a Tactical Weapon for the first time each turn, for every <color=#F74848>1</color> AP cost, DMG <color=#F74848>+4%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>20%</color>.

400035.name: Indiscriminate 3
400035.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> is triggered, allow continued moving with the remaining movement.

400036.name: Indiscriminate 4
400036.SpecificEffects: After triggering <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, it no longer reduces final damage.

400441.name: Private Security 1
400441.SpecificEffects: When both shoulders are equipped with Rocket Launchers, Rocket DMG <color=#F74848>+10%</color>.

400043.name: Power Innovation 3
400043.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, additionally restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

400444.name: Private Security 2
400444.SpecificEffects: Rocket Launcher Range <color=#F74848>+1</color>, while the attack area remains the same.

400445.name: Private Security 3
400445.SpecificEffects: When applying debuffs and Terrain effects, duration <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

400446.name: Private Security 4
400446.SpecificEffects: AP Regen effect of <buf ID=4004501>[Unceasing Thunderfire]</buf> <color=#F74848>+1</color>.
